shots.meaning: put separate parts together to form a whole
shots.example: The course is composed of four units.
shots.visualAction: Xiaohei places separate blank pieces together in one tray until they form a tidy whole.
shots.purpose: Shows com- as together and compose as forming a whole from parts.

states.prompt: Keep the accepted Xiaohei identity and camera. Show three separate blank pieces beside an empty orange tray; Xiaohei has not placed them together yet.
Keep the exact same character, camera, tray and scale. Xiaohei is placing the second blank piece into the orange tray while one piece remains outside.
Keep the exact same character, camera, tray and scale. The three blank pieces are now together as one tidy stack in the tray; Xiaohei holds the completed whole calmly.

Keep the exact same character, camera, cover, card and scale. Xiaohei holds the cover aside and the pale-blue card is fully visible.
